literal: On day dingmao, Fan Yanguang, Jin's military governor of the Tianxiong Army, secretly sent men asking to defect; they were not accepted.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Fan Yanguang, Jin's governor of the Tianxiong Army, secretly sent men offering to defect; the court refused them.

literal: On day jisi, Langjun Dieligu and Meili Dielie were dispatched as envoys to Jin.
idiomatic: On jisi day Langjun Dieligu and Meili Dielie were sent as envoys to Jin.

literal: On day renwu, Jin envoys and envoys from the various states came to audience.
idiomatic: On renwu day envoys from Jin and from the tributary states were received at court.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day jiashen, there was an earthquake.
idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiashen day, the earth shook.

literal: He went to Pingdi Pine Forest and viewed the source of the Huang River.
idiomatic: He traveled to Pingdi Pine Forest to view the Huang River's source.

literal: In the fifth month, on day jiayin, he went to Pinbi Marsh.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin day, he went to Pinbi Marsh.

literal: On day renshen, Kaihuang Hall was shaken.
idiomatic: On renshen day Kaihuang Hall was shaken.

literal: In the sixth month, on day jiashen, Jin sent Minister of Revenue Nie Yanhuo and others to request that he accept an elevated title, return the lands north of Yanmen together with You and Ji, and continue submitting three hundred thousand bolts of cloth annually; an edict refused.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiashen day, Jin dispatched Minister of Revenue Nie Yanhuo and others to ask that he take an honorific title, restore the territory north of Yanmen along with You and Ji, and receive three hundred thousand bolts of silk each year; he refused by edict.

literal: On day gengxu, Attendant-in-Chief Lie Lüeyan reported that Fan Yanguang had rebelled against Jin and was leading troops south.
idiomatic: On gengxu day Attendant-in-Chief Lie Lüeyan reported that Fan Yanguang had turned against Jin and was marching south with his army.

literal: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh month of autumn, an edict ordered all tribes to prepare arms and armor.
idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered every tribe to ready arms and armor.

literal: On day guichou, he went to Huai Prefecture and paid respects at Fengling.
idiomatic: On guichou day he went to Huai Prefecture and visited Fengling.

literal: On day jiazi, Jin sent envoys reporting Fan Yanguang's rebellion.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Jin sent envoys announcing that Fan Yanguang had rebelled.

literal: On day gengwu, Yelü Niaoguli was dispatched to Jin to discuss military affairs.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Yelü Niaoguli was sent to Jin to consult on military matters.

literal: In the eighth month, on day guiwei, Jin again sent envoys requesting an elevated title; it was not granted.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei day, Jin again sent envoys asking for an honorific title; he again refused.

literal: On day gengyin, Jin, Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan, and Li Jing of Southern Tang each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengyin day Jin, Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan, and Li Jing of Southern Tang all dispatched tribute envoys.

literal: On day gengzi, Jin sent envoys announcing that the capital was at Bian and that Fan Yanguang had surrendered.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Jin sent envoys reporting that the court had moved to Bian and that Fan Yanguang had submitted.

literal: In the ninth month, on day renzi, the Bigude came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day, the Bigude brought tribute.

literal: On day gengshen, Zhiligu was dispatched as envoy to Jin and Southern Tang.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Zhiligu was sent as envoy to Jin and Southern Tang.

literal: On day guihai, the Shibugu and Jurchen came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On guihai day the Shibugu and Jurchen came with tribute.

literal: On day xinwei, envoys were dispatched to Goryeo and the Iron Li.
idiomatic: On xinwei day envoys were sent to Goryeo and the Iron Li.

literal: On day guiyou, the Uighur came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the Uighur brought tribute.

literal: On the gengchen new moon of the tenth month of winter, the Grand Empress Dowager's Yongning Festival; Jin, the Uighur, Dunhuang, and other states all sent envoys with congratulations.
idiomatic: That winter, on the gengchen new moon of the tenth month, for the Grand Empress Dowager's Yongning Festival, Jin, the Uighur, Dunhuang, and other states all sent envoys to offer congratulations.

literal: On day renwu, an edict ordered the Uighur envoys Huluozhi and Alibao questioned about their customs.
idiomatic: On renwu day an edict directed that the Uighur envoys Huluozhi and Alibao be questioned about their people's customs.

literal: On day dinghai, as the envoys of the various states returned, Puli Gu Pishi Humoli was sent out with them to their countries.
idiomatic: On dinghai day, as the foreign envoys took their leave, Puli Gu Pishi Humoli was dispatched with them to their homelands.

literal: In the eleventh month, on day jiwei, envoys were dispatched to Jin to request a physician.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, envoys were sent to Jin to ask for a doctor.

literal: On day dingmao, the Iron Li came to pay tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the Iron Li brought tribute.

literal: In the twelfth month, on day jiashen, he went east on tour and sacrificed at Mount Muye.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiashen day, he toured eastward and offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

literal: On day jichou, the physician arrived.
idiomatic: On jichou day the physician came.
